options.name: maxTokensToSample
options.description: The maximum number of tokens to generate in the completion

options.name: temperature
options.description: Controls randomness: Lowering results in less random completions. As the temperature approaches zero, the model will become deterministic and repetitive.

options.name: topP
options.description: Controls diversity via nucleus sampling: 0.5 means half of all likelihood-weighted options are considered. We generally recommend altering this or temperature but not both.

options.name: maxRetries
options.description: Maximum number of retries to attempt when a request fails

options.name: timeout
options.description: Maximum amount of time a request is allowed to take in milliseconds. Increase this for long generations; set to 0 to disable.

options.name: additionalModelRequestFields
options.description: Model-family-specific inference parameters passed through as JSON (e.g. Claude top_k/thinking, Nova inferenceConfig/reasoningConfig, Cohere penalties). See the AWS model parameters docs.

options.name: latency
options.description: Latency optimization mode for the request. "Optimized" can reduce response time for supported models and regions.

options.name: guardrail
options.description: Apply an Amazon Bedrock guardrail to requests

values.name: guardrailIdentifier
values.description: The identifier (ID or ARN) of the guardrail to apply

values.name: guardrailVersion
values.description: The version of the guardrail to apply, e.g. "1". Defaults to the working draft ("DRAFT").

values.name: trace
values.description: The trace behavior for the guardrail
